svg.title: Enterprise LLM Gateway — Google Cloud Phase 1 detailed topology
svg.desc: Single-region GCP deployment: HTTPS load balancer, Cloud Run plus GKE, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, private Vector DB, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager and Workload Identity, observability, and controlled egress.

-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Single-region HA · hybrid Cloud Run + GKE · same Gateway binary as the future Private DC target · fail-closed unauthenticated traffic
